annotations.text:
FLEET OVERVIEW — the Workshop Controller's morning view.

Covers FR-40 (fleet table), FR-43 (sort by soonest due), FR-46 (status colour) and FR-21 (composite "2K+13K" labels, existing convention).

The sidebar's bottom card is the pitch: recall timing precision, +/-90 km today vs +/-6 km with Railtech. That number is from TDD Appendix A and is currently buried in the report.

SINGLE LRV — covers FR-41 (distance to each of the five thresholds) and FR-42 (projected due DATE, not km remaining).

Five cycle tiles, each showing km-since / nominal and the date it crosses. Far-out cycles show month-level dates, which is honest about the precision.

Bottom-left chart is the "bounded, not cumulative" argument from TDD 6.1 — error resets at every anchor rather than drifting. It answers the main technical objection an operator panel will raise.

MAINTENANCE PLANNER — this page is the differentiator; nothing in the brief asks for it.

Auto-ranked plan (overdue risk, then tolerance-band position, then bay availability), bundling (D07's 2K+13K in one visit), and a real capacity constraint.

The bottom-right card closes the loop nobody else will build: a projected capacity conflict two weeks out, resolved by changing DEPLOYMENT today rather than by deferring maintenance later. Needs a bay-capacity figure and per-cycle bay hours, neither of which exists in the schema yet.

TECHNICIAN APP — same deployment, a route in the same app, phone-shaped.

Covers FR-20/21/23/24/25/27 and targets NFR-06 (under 45 s from vehicle selection to commit) — hence three decisions on one screen, no wizard.

The OCR confidence chip and the plausibility check answer NFR-07: no silent wrong commits. The dark panel is a stand-in for the captured photo.
